title: Stale-or-unreachable metering degradation rules with fail-open local-core behavior and fail-closed optional managed-action gates
summary: Frozen stale-or-unreachable metering degradation rules for the managed lanes. Each rule projects its control-plane lane's fail posture so the local core fails open and keeps running, gates exactly one optional managed action when the lane fails closed and spend cannot be bounded, names the affected service family, the local-safe promise, the blocking reason, and the retry and details actions, and narrows the marketed claim to managed-narrowed without ever collapsing the local core to local-safe-only.

rules.title: Managed AI gateway — meter stale
rules.summary: When the meter or rating data is stale and the managed number cannot be confirmed now, Managed AI gateway keeps its local-safe baseline running and the managed number is labeled and shown bounded while the optional action continues.
local_safe_promise: Direct and bring-your-own-key AI routes keep running.
Local editing, search, and Git are unaffected.

details_action.label: Open service health to see the affected service and its last contact time.

rules.recovery_cue: The number refreshes when the meter reconnects; local editing, search, Git, and existing local automation continue now.

surface_bindings.summary: Service-health and diagnostics surfaces render each rule's degradation trigger, fail posture, local-safe promise, gated action with its blocking reason, and the retry and details actions.
The account and usage surface labels a stale or unreachable meter, names the local-safe promise, and never shows a spend or quota number without its unit, as-of time, and scope owner.
The Help/About truth surface states that a stale or unreachable metering path narrows only the relevant managed action and never local editing, search, Git, or existing local automation.
Support and admin export packets carry each fail-closed rule's gated action, its blocking reason, the fail posture, and the last-contact as-of time.
Claim and public-truth automation narrows a marketed managed claim to managed-narrowed when its metering evidence goes stale or unreachable, never collapsing it to local-safe-only.
